name: Toss To Trash
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: TOP_G2026
description: TossToTrash is a server-side Fabric mod that eliminates entity lag by replacing dropped items with a virtual disposal bin. Players simply use the /trash command to open a UI where items are permanently deleted upon closing.
roadmap: Minecraft's libraries and client API (0.2), Code next to data (0.3), Machines (0.4)
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
